body.escapeReason: runner parsed TAP counters (# pass/# fail) while Node>=22 emits the spec reporter; zero-parse fell through to QUALIFIED because no positive-count guard existed
proposedProtection: pin the reporter a parser consumes (--test-reporter tap)
treat zero/empty parsed denominators as failure, never success
regression-test verdict emission against real runner output

preconditions: the component emits or consumes a counted verdict (tests passed/failed, coverage satisfied, denominators)
steps: before emitting a counted verdict, pin the exact reporter/format the parser consumes (e.g. --test-reporter tap)
treat a zero or unparsed denominator as a failure signal: refuse the verdict, never pass vacuously
keep a regression test that runs the real command and asserts a positive count is parsed
failureAndInverse: a silently empty denominator is a false-green amplifier: every subsequent approval built on it is fabricated

firstProof.oracle: a qualification verdict is emitted only when the parsed denominator is positive AND the reporter was explicitly pinned

originAnalysis.uncertainty: root cause verified live: spec-reporter output parsed as TAP -> 0/0 -> vacuous QUALIFIED

limits: applies to counted/parsed oracles; boolean non-counted checks need their own fail-closed proof
